in_marathi.name: Jankiyaa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jankiyaa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Jankiyaa is derived from the Sanskrit language and means 'God's Grace'. This name is often given to a boy in the Hindu tradition to signify the presence of the divine in his life.
